scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:web
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm run build:web && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.118.0 deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:inline: pnpm run build:web && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/embed-cloudflare-assets.ts && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.118.0 deploy --config wrangler.inline.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:dev: pnpm run build:web && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.118.0 dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:local: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.118.0 d1 migrations apply zhaolu-route-finder --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:remote: pnpm dlx wrangler@4.118.0 d1 migrations apply zhaolu-route-finder --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test tests/route-recommendation-core.test.ts tests/scoring.test.ts tests/amap-adapters.test.ts tests/amap-smoke.test.ts tests/worldcover-adapter.test.ts tests/worldcover-smoke.test.ts tests/server-api.test.ts tests/server-api-smoke.test.ts tests/staging-smoke.test.ts tests/operations-smoke.test.ts tests/city-acceptance.test.ts tests/load-test.test.ts tests/security-gate.test.ts tests/release-readiness.test.ts tests/web-client.test.ts tests/route-delivery.test.ts tests/user-data.test.ts tests/cloudflare-adapters.test.ts tests/runtime-operations.test.ts tests/database-backup.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:core && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.verify:amap: pnpm run typecheck:amap && pnpm run test:amap
scripts.verify:cloudflare: pnpm run typecheck:cloudflare && pnpm run test:cloudflare
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:route-core: pnpm run typecheck:route-core && pnpm run test:route-core
scripts.verify:server-api: pnpm run typecheck:server-api && pnpm run test:server-api
scripts.verify:user-data: pnpm run typecheck:user-data && pnpm run test:user-data
scripts.verify:web-unit: pnpm run typecheck:web-unit && pnpm run test:web-unit
scripts.verify:worldcover: pnpm run typecheck:worldcover && pnpm run test:worldcover
